title: Shell crossings and the Tolman model
relevance: Primary: necessary and sufficient no-shell-crossing conditions for Tolman/LTB dust; simultaneous-bang discussion; regular maxima; counterexample to Zel'dovich-Grishchuk recollapse hypothesis
exact_version: Astrophys. J. 290, 381-387 (1985 March 15), DOI 10.1086/162995; erratum ApJ 300, 461 (1986), DOI 10.1086/163822 (erratum metadata only, NOT read)
locators: Appendix: shell-crossing properties independent of equation of state
assumptions: Spherically symmetric comoving dust (Tolman metric ds2=-dt2+r'^2/(1+f)dR2+r2dOmega2); arbitrary functions a(R) bang time, f(R) energy, F(R) mass; no shell crossing = r'=0 with density divergence; t>a branch (t<a by reflection)
conclusion: Elliptic r'>0: a'<0, [recollapse-time monotonicity bound on a'], F'>0. Hyperbolic: a'<0, f'>0, F>0, F'>0; necessary and sufficient. Regular maxima need F'=f'=a'=0 at one R. Simultaneous bang a'=0 compatible with the conditions. Quoted sufficient conditions (r'>0,F'>0) too restrictive.
proof_status: Necessary-and-sufficient derivation read; displayed equations partially OCR-garbled in scan, (2.25b) not transcribed
dependencies: Lemaître 1933, Tolman 1934, Bondi 1947 (metric), Hellaby-Lake 1984 (ApJ 282,1), Lake 1984a,b, Zel'dovich-Grishchuk 1984
open_questions: Read the erratum ApJ 300, 461 and reconcile with (2.25b)
Transcribe (2.25b) from a clean scan and check equivalence with Sussman's bracket M'/M-(3/2)E'/E+c t_bb'|E|^{3/2}/(2 pi M)
limits: ADS scan OCR: eqs. (2.5) and (2.25b) garbled and NOT transcribed; erratum ApJ 300,461 not read

assumptions: Data: g-bar in M_s, k-bar in H_{s-1}, v-bar in H_{s-1}, r-bar in H_{s-2}, s>n/2+2, |v-bar|<1; r-bar>=0 and omega-bar=supp(r-bar) for the physical (extension-independent) statement; matter-vacuum interface regularized by r-bar vanishing at the boundary
